news.title: Nvidia-backed Aussie AI firm Firmus withdraws historic IPO, citing market volatility
news.summary: Nvidia-backed Australian AI data center operator Firmus has withdrawn its planned IPO amid market volatility.

news.title: Tokenization could unleash tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital, Nasdaq CEO says
news.summary: Nasdaq CEO Adena Friedman said tokenization could free up tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital.

news.title: Cramer says Thursday's AI sell-off proves the value of this age-old investing strategy
news.summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said Thursday’s sell-off in AI stocks underscores the importance of diversification, even when it means holding stocks that have struggled.

news.title: SpaceX deal to acquire spectrum license hammers shares of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile

news.title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report

news.title: U.S. suspends Microsoft, Adobe from green card labor program in foreign worker crackdown

news.title: Trump bought up to $25 million in Meta and millions in SpaceX debt in August

news.title: Amazon overhauls aging devices lineup with higher-priced Alexa tablet, dumping the budget Fire

news.title: Russia's internet giant Yandex halts operations at major data center after drone attack
news.summary: Russian internet giant Yandex paused operations inside one of its data centers after a drone attack as Ukraine continues to hit the country's infrastructure.

news.summary: The deal is handing the AI agent developer fresh capital after Beijing forced Meta to unwind its roughly $2 billion acquisition.

news.title: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip
news.summary: The new device shows Microsoft remains committed to making its own PCs even though it's not one of the top device makers.

news.title: Ex-Flipkart Execs Press Walmart to Buy Out Stock Options
news.summary: A group of former Flipkart executives is urging parent Walmart Inc. to buy out their stock options, seeking to cash in while the US retailer weighs options including a separate listing for the India e-commerce operator.

news.title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus IPO Collapses as AI Valuation Concerns Grow
news.summary: Firmus Grid Ltd. abandoned its attempt at one of Australia’s biggest-ever initial public offerings, after the Nvidia Corp.-backed data center company failed to lure global investors who’ve grown increasingly skittish over frothy AI valuations.

news.title: Nvidia-Backed Lumentum Sees Opto-Parts Capacity Sold Out to 2029
news.summary: Lumentum Holdings Inc.’s optoelectronic parts are “completely sold out” through almost 2029 on demand from tech companies clamoring for faster AI data centers.

news.title: Meta Bans TikTok Parent ByteDance From Advertising on Its Apps in 7 Countries
news.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. banned advertisements in the US from ByteDance Ltd., the former controlling owner of TikTok, intensifying the competition with the popular social video site.

news.title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus IPO Being Pulled Sends AI Funding Warning
news.summary: The dramatic cancellation of an Nvidia-backed data center company’s initial public offering is revealing fresh cracks in the AI funding boom.

news.title: China's Delivery Robots Are Learning to Tackle the Night Shift
news.summary: Autonomous vehicle companies believe there’s a huge market opportunity in delivering after dark, if the technical challenges can be overcome.

news.title: Xbox Expands Movie, TV Ambitions With New Division
news.summary: Microsoft Corp.’s Xbox unit is formalizing its film and TV foray with a new division focused on expanding the video-game giant’s franchises into other media.

news.title: Baiju Bhatt on New Company, Plans for Data Centers in Space
news.summary: Baiju Bhatt, Cowboy Space’s Founder and CEO, says the company is developing an energy grid in orbit. Its first satellite, Reason 1, reached orbit on a SpaceX rideshare, and the team has made contact and is communicating with it daily. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Siebert Williams Shank CEO on 30 Year Anniversary
news.summary: Suzanne Shank discussed how Siebert Williams Shank has expanded since launching in 1996 as a municipal bond underwriter. The firm now works across corporate debt markets, serves 80 of the Fortune 100, and remains active in municipals, with growth supported by mergers and acquisitions. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Applied Digital CEO on Q1 Results
news.summary: Applied Digital shares fell about 2.5% after its earnings report, despite first-quarter revenue rising more than 320% year over year and beating estimates. news.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected

news.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
news.summary: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.

news.title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
news.summary: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.

news.title: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
news.summary: OpenAI's flood of proofs deviated from the guidelines set by a group of mathematical researchers consulted by the frontier lab.

news.title: A startup founder who served time in prison is looking to court an untapped market: ex-cons
news.summary: Richard Bronson, a former Stratton Oakmont partner who served time in federal prison for securities violations, has launched Commissary Club, a startup that uses AI to help people leaving prison find jobs, housing, community, and even dates.

news.title: Natura’s $99 smart ring puts AI agents on your finger
news.summary: Natura’s $99 Interface smart ring lets you summon AI agents with the press of a finger to complete tasks, capture thoughts, and control devices — while doubling as a health tracker.

news.title: Goodfire says its new ‘inside-out’ monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost
news.summary: Goodfire just launched what it says is a cheaper way to keep AI agents in check: Instead of paying a second AI to read everything an agent does, its monitors peek inside the model while it works and only call in backup when something looks fishy.

news.title: US bars Microsoft, Adobe, and major IT firms from green card program for skilled foreign workers
news.summary: The other firms being suspended from the program include Capgemini, Cognizant, HCL, Infosys, Tata, and Wipro.

news.title: Elon Musk questions Ambani’s influence as Starlink India launch stalls
